about: Thandak fix rules v2. Family fixes are triggered by household answers and today's heat level; satellite area causes only boost ranking and add a 'because' line for families, and trigger colony/government fixes. Effect numbers are ranges from cited sources; null means no reliable number yet. Cost bands and thresholds marked needs_verification must go through verified_numbers.csv before launch.

tier.today: today's heat: free actions that change with the forecast

climate.semi_arid: Hot and dry, e.g. Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Delhi (pre-monsoon)
climate.tropical_savanna: Seasonally humid, e.g. Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai
climate.humid: Humid most of the year, e.g. Mumbai, Kolkata, coastal cities

effect_metric.outdoor_air: Outdoor air temperature near ground, degC lower
effect_metric.exposure: Does not lower temperature; reduces how much heat people are exposed to

evidence_level.measured: Measured in published study or official policy document
evidence_level.review: Global review of many studies; not India-specific
evidence_level.program_claim: Reported by an implementing organisation; not a controlled study
evidence_level.qualitative: Well-established practice, but no reliable number for Indian homes yet
evidence_level.guideline: From official Indian heat guidelines (NDMA / NCDC)

rank_group.core: basic daily plan for every home

evaporative_max_rh_pct.note: Above this afternoon humidity, khus screens and coolers stop helping. Move into verified_numbers.csv with a source.

afternoon_window_hours.note: Forecast hours averaged for 'afternoon humidity' (12:00 to 16:59).

always.en: Part of every home's daily plan
always.hi: हर घर के रोज़ के प्लान का हिस्सा

household.top_floor.hi: सबसे ऊपर की मंज़िल वाला घर

household.vulnerable.en: Elderly, baby or ill person at home
household.vulnerable.hi: घर में बुज़ुर्ग, छोटा बच्चा या बीमार व्यक्ति

household.no_cross_ventilation.hi: घर में आर-पार हवा नहीं आती

household.outdoor_worker.hi: घर का कोई सदस्य बाहर काम करता है

dry_afternoon.hi: दोपहर में हवा सूखी रहेगी ({rh}% नमी)

over_budget_subsidy.en: Above your budget. Check cool-roof subsidies or NGO programmes
over_budget_subsidy.hi: आपके बजट से ज़्यादा। कूल-रूफ़ सब्सिडी या NGO की योजनाएँ देखें

climate.en: Not suited to your area's climate
climate.hi: आपके इलाक़े के मौसम के लिए सही नहीं

heat_index.hi: महसूस होने वाली गर्मी {lo}–{hi} °C तक कम

exposure.en: Lowers your exposure, not the temperature
exposure.hi: तापमान नहीं घटाता, गर्मी से बचाता है

unmeasured_family.en: No reliable number yet. Note your indoor temperature before and after
unmeasured_family.hi: अभी कोई पक्का आँकड़ा नहीं। पहले और बाद में घर का तापमान नोट करें

global_only.en: Range comes from a global review, not a promise for your area
global_only.hi: यह आँकड़ा दुनिया भर के अध्ययनों से है, आपके इलाक़े के लिए पक्का नहीं

nrdc_telangana.title: Telangana Announces a Groundbreaking Cool Roof Policy (NRDC)

epic_mht.title: A cool idea on the roof can bring down slum home heat (EPIC India)

cam_trees.title: Wrong trees in the wrong place can make cities hotter at night (University of Cambridge)

iitgn_humid.title: Cooling cities needs climate-smart design, not just more trees (Mongabay India, on IIT Gandhinagar / Northeastern study of 138 Indian cities)

cpr_hap.title: Most heat action plans in India are not suited to local contexts (Down To Earth, on CPR review of 37 HAPs)

isprs_jaipur.title: Jaipur surface and atmospheric UHI with Random Forest (ISPRS Annals 2026)

thandak_ndma.title: NDMA heatwave guidelines (link the entry already on Thandak's Data & sources page)

thandak_ncdc.title: NCDC heat-related illness guidelines (link the existing Thandak source)

thandak_fan_studies.title: Fan-use limits, Meade 2024 and Morris 2021 (same sources as Thandak's fan advice)

causes.label_hi: गर्मी सोखने वाली गहरे रंग की छतें

detect.note: Active when SHAP contribution of low roof albedo to the cell's surface temperature anomaly is >= 0.3 degC

causes.label_hi: घनी इमारतें और कम हवा का बहाव

causes.label_en: Hot nights (walls and roofs release stored heat)
causes.label_hi: गर्म रातें (दीवारें और छतें जमा गर्मी छोड़ती हैं)

detect.note: Night surface temp anomaly vs city average

fixes.title_en: Close windows and curtains in the hot hours, open them at night
fixes.title_hi: गर्म घंटों में खिड़कियाँ-पर्दे बंद रखें, रात में खोलें
steps: Use Thandak's hourly plan: keep windows shut while outside is hotter than inside
Open windows on opposite sides once outside is cooler, usually after sunset

fixes.title_en: Keep elderly, babies and ill family members in the coolest room
fixes.title_hi: बुज़ुर्गों, छोटे बच्चों और बीमारों को घर के सबसे ठंडे कमरे में रखें
steps: From noon to 5 pm keep them in the coolest room, usually the lowest floor and away from sun-facing walls
Check on them often and keep giving water, even if they don't ask
At the first warning signs of heat illness, cool them down and call for help
steps_hi: दोपहर 12 से शाम 5 बजे तक उन्हें सबसे ठंडे कमरे में रखें — अक्सर सबसे नीचे की मंज़िल, धूप वाली दीवार से दूर
बार-बार उनका हाल पूछें और पानी पिलाते रहें, भले वे ख़ुद न माँगें
लू लगने के पहले लक्षण दिखते ही उन्हें ठंडा करें और मदद के लिए फ़ोन करें

fixes.title_en: Know when the fan stops helping
fixes.title_hi: जानें कब पंखा मदद करना बंद कर देता है
steps: Your hourly plan shows when the fan helps and when it stops helping
Above that limit the fan can add heat: wet your skin or clothes and stay in front of it, or move to a cooler room
The limit is lower for elderly and ill family members
steps_hi: आपके घंटेवार प्लान में दिखता है कि पंखा कब मदद करता है और कब नहीं
उस सीमा के ऊपर पंखा गर्मी बढ़ा सकता है: त्वचा या कपड़े गीले करके पंखे के सामने बैठें, या किसी ठंडे कमरे में चले जाएँ
बुज़ुर्गों और बीमार लोगों के लिए यह सीमा और कम होती है

fixes.title_en: Your cooler will work well this afternoon
fixes.title_hi: आज दोपहर कूलर अच्छा काम करेगा
steps: Keep a window or door slightly open so the moist air can escape
Empty and dry the tank once a week so mosquitoes can't breed
steps_hi: एक खिड़की या दरवाज़ा थोड़ा खुला रखें ताकि नमी वाली हवा बाहर निकल सके
हफ़्ते में एक बार टंकी खाली करके सुखाएँ, ताकि मच्छर न पनपें

fixes.title_en: Too humid for the cooler this afternoon
fixes.title_hi: आज दोपहर कूलर के लिए उमस ज़्यादा है
steps: In humid air the cooler adds moisture but barely cools: run it on fan-only mode or use a fan
Keep air moving through the house
steps_hi: उमस में कूलर ठंडक कम और नमी ज़्यादा देता है: इसे सिर्फ़ पंखे वाले मोड पर चलाएँ या पंखा चलाएँ
घर में हवा का बहाव बनाए रखें

fixes.title_en: No through-breeze? Pull night air in with a fan
fixes.title_hi: आर-पार हवा नहीं आती? रात में पंखे से ठंडी हवा अंदर खींचें
steps: After sunset, once it is cooler outside, put a fan in one window facing out
Open a window or door on the other side so cooler air is pulled in
steps_hi: सूरज ढलने के बाद, जब बाहर ठंडक हो, एक खिड़की में पंखा बाहर की तरफ़ मुँह करके रखें
दूसरी तरफ़ की खिड़की या दरवाज़ा खोलें, ताकि ठंडी हवा अंदर खिंचे

fixes.title_en: Protect family members who work outdoors
fixes.title_hi: बाहर काम करने वालों का ख़ास ध्यान रखें
steps: Avoid heavy work in the sun between 12 and 3 pm when possible
Drink water often, even without feeling thirsty, and carry ORS
Rest in the shade and stop work at the first signs of heat illness
steps_hi: जहाँ तक हो सके, दोपहर 12 से 3 बजे के बीच धूप में भारी काम न करें
प्यास न लगे तब भी बार-बार पानी पिएँ और ORS साथ रखें
छाँव में आराम करें और लू के पहले लक्षण दिखते ही काम रोक दें

fixes.title_en: Wet khus or jute screen on sun-facing windows
fixes.title_hi: धूप वाली खिड़कियों पर गीली खस या जूट की चिक
steps: Hang khus or jute on west- and south-facing windows
Keep it damp during the afternoon
Keep the window slightly open so air passes through the wet screen
fixes.avoid_if: Humidity is high - evaporation stops working and the room feels muggier

fixes.title_en: Shade windows from outside (bamboo chik, awning, chajja)
fixes.title_hi: खिड़कियों को बाहर से छाया दें (बाँस की चिक, छज्जा)
steps: Shade outside the glass - inside curtains let the heat in first
Prioritise west-facing windows (afternoon sun)

fixes.title_en: Lime-wash or white-paint the roof
fixes.title_hi: छत पर चूना या सफ़ेद पेंट करें

effect.note: Reported 'up to 2 degC' for white-painted roofs

steps: Clean the roof surface
Apply 2 coats of lime-wash or white paint
Re-apply each year before summer - it gets dirty and loses reflectance

fixes.title_en: Professional cool-roof (solar reflective) coating
fixes.title_hi: पेशेवर कूल-रूफ (धूप लौटाने वाली) कोटिंग

effect.note: Depends on location, roof type and reflectance

steps: Choose a coating with a stated high solar reflectance
Check if your city or state has a cool-roof subsidy
Clean once a year to keep it reflective

fixes.title_en: Replace or cover tin/asbestos roof with an insulated modular roof
fixes.title_hi: टिन/एस्बेस्टस छत को इंसुलेटेड मॉड्यूलर छत से बदलें या ढकें

effect.note: Program-reported by Mahila Housing Trust (Ahmedabad, Bhopal)

steps: Ask local NGOs or housing trusts about modular roof programmes
Do not cut or break asbestos sheets yourself - the dust is harmful

fixes.title_en: False ceiling or under-roof insulation
fixes.title_hi: फ़ॉल्स सीलिंग या छत के नीचे इंसुलेशन
steps: Leave a ventilated air gap between roof and ceiling
Combine with a cool roof for the best result

fixes.title_en: Plant a native shade tree on the west or south side
fixes.title_hi: पश्चिम या दक्षिण की ओर देसी छायादार पेड़ लगाएँ
steps: Choose native species such as neem or arjuna
Plant where it will shade walls and windows in the afternoon

fixes.title_en: Heat-day check-ins for elderly and ill residents
fixes.title_hi: गर्मी के दिनों में बुज़ुर्गों और बीमारों की खोज-खबर

effect.note: Reduces health risk, does not lower temperature

steps: Make a volunteer list in the RWA group
Trigger check-ins automatically when Thandak shows High or above

fixes.title_en: Shaded rest spots and drinking-water points
fixes.title_hi: छायादार विश्राम स्थल और पीने के पानी के स्टैंड

effect.note: Reduces exposure, does not lower temperature

steps: Place near gates, markets and bus stops
Prioritise spots used by vendors, guards and delivery workers

fixes.title_en: Colony-wide cool-roof painting drive
fixes.title_hi: पूरी कॉलोनी में कूल-रूफ पेंटिंग अभियान

effect.note: Per home. At city scale, reflective roofs + pavements + shade trees together could lower summer air temperature about 2 degC

steps: Use Thandak's roof map to count dark roofs in the colony
Buy coating in bulk through the RWA for a lower price
Start with top-floor homes and homes with elderly residents

fixes.title_en: Shade sails or pergolas over lanes, parks and waiting spots
fixes.title_hi: गलियों, पार्कों और रुकने की जगहों पर छाया के शेड
steps: Shade the most-used walking routes and bus stops first
Use light-coloured, breathable fabric so hot air can escape

fixes.title_en: Plant dense native shade trees
fixes.title_hi: घने देसी छायादार पेड़ लगाएँ

effect.note: Global review: just over 9 degC daytime cooling at pedestrian level in arid climates, but up to 0.4 degC night warming. In semi-arid Indian cities dense canopies consistently improved cooling

steps: Prefer native species such as neem and arjuna over ornamental trees
Plant on bare ground and along south/west edges of streets

fixes.title_en: Plant spaced-out trees that keep air moving
fixes.title_hi: दूरी पर पेड़ लगाएँ ताकि हवा चलती रहे

effect.note: In humid Indian cities, very dense canopy raised feels-like heat by up to 2 degC. Use sparse planting with open gaps for airflow

steps: Space trees out and keep gaps aligned with the prevailing wind
Combine with built shade where streets are narrow
fixes.avoid_if: Do not plant dense clusters in packed, humid areas - they trap moisture and block wind

fixes.title_en: Light-coloured or permeable paving for open areas
fixes.title_hi: खुली जगहों पर हल्के रंग की या पानी सोखने वाली पेविंग
steps: Replace dark asphalt in parking and courtyards when it is due for repair
Use grass pavers where cars park rarely

fixes.title_en: Revive ponds and add rainwater harvesting
fixes.title_hi: तालाबों को पुनर्जीवित करें, वर्षा जल संचयन करें
steps: Use Thandak's water-change map to find dried water bodies nearby
Work with the municipality - this usually needs public land and budget

fixes.title_en: Heat alerts using local thresholds (including humidity and hot nights)
fixes.title_hi: स्थानीय सीमाओं (नमी और गर्म रातों सहित) पर आधारित हीट अलर्ट

effect.note: Only 10 of 37 reviewed heat action plans used locally set thresholds

steps: Set ward-level thresholds from local data, not national defaults
Include humidity, night temperature and heat-wave duration

fixes.title_en: Open cooling centres in the highest-risk wards
fixes.title_hi: सबसे जोखिम वाले वार्डों में कूलिंग सेंटर खोलें

effect.note: Reduces exposure, does not lower temperature

steps: Use Thandak's ward ranking to choose locations
Use existing schools, community halls and health centres

fixes.title_en: Shift outdoor work hours on heat days
fixes.title_hi: गर्मी के दिनों में बाहरी काम के घंटे बदलें

effect.note: Reduces exposure, does not lower temperature

steps: Pause heavy outdoor work during peak hours on High/Very high days
Apply to municipal staff and construction sites first

fixes.title_en: Ward-level heat vulnerability assessment
fixes.title_hi: वार्ड-स्तरीय गर्मी संवेदनशीलता आकलन

effect.note: Only 2 of 37 reviewed heat action plans did a heat-specific vulnerability assessment

steps: Combine exposure (Thandak heat maps), sensitivity (elderly, slums, outdoor workers) and adaptive capacity
Use the ranking to target every other fix in this list

fixes.title_en: Cool-roof programme for low-income and government housing
fixes.title_hi: कम आय और सरकारी आवास के लिए कूल-रूफ कार्यक्रम
steps: Start with wards that have many tin/asbestos roofs and high vulnerability
Telangana's policy covers all new and existing government low-cost housing

fixes.title_en: Make cool roofs mandatory in building rules
fixes.title_hi: भवन नियमों में कूल रूफ अनिवार्य करें

effect.note: Citywide, reflective roofs and pavements together with shade trees could lower summer air temperature about 2 degC. Roofs alone would do less.

steps: Model on Telangana: mandatory for government, commercial and large residential buildings
Telangana targets 300 sq km of cool roofs by 2028

fixes.title_en: Climate-matched urban forest and green corridors
fixes.title_hi: जलवायु के अनुसार शहरी वन और हरित गलियारे
steps: Dry cities: dense native canopy. Humid cities: spaced canopy with ventilation corridors
Track canopy and heat change yearly with Thandak's satellite layers

ranking.about: Today tier: safety, then core, then advice. Other tiers: fixes with a measured or programme-reported number first, then the rest; within each group score = effect x evidence x cost x (1 + area bonus). Tune after before/after readings.
